chapters.title: Consider your ways
chapters.summary: The returned exiles have built their own paneled houses while God's temple lies in ruins. Consider your ways, says Haggai. The leaders and people obey and begin work.

chapters.title: The latter glory
chapters.summary: God encourages the builders: be strong, for I am with you. The glory of this house will be greater than the former. Zerubbabel will be like a signet ring.
